State Council
Administration of
Industrial Training
Institute
(Establishment and
Committed
Expenditure)
column7:
Augmentation inprovision
of ₹162.52 lakh was the
net effect of increase of
₹222.03 lakh and decrease
by re-appropriation of
₹59.51 lakh. Increase was
attributed to need of
additional amounts in
payment of rented van,
Exam related expenses,
rent paid and tax item.
Decrease was attributed to
anticipated saving.
Reasons for final saving
have not been intimated
(July 2024).
